clips.title: The story
paras: At Stonetalon Peak, Keeper Albagorm watches the Charred Vale burn and seeks help healing the wilds.

Keeper Albagorm guards the night elven refuge at Stonetalon Peak. Like other sons of Cenarius, he feels the pain of the natural world. South of the peak, the Charred Vale lies scorched by a greedy mechanized army of industrialists. Bloodfury harpies now hold the ruins and prevent new growth. From his sanctuary, Albagorm works to halt the corruption and restore balance to the wounded forest.
